action_description: Preserved the f1aa1c2d grouped GEMM structure and changed only FP4 load/dequant in stage1_grouped_gemm_kernel and stage2_grouped_gemm_kernel: scalar switch decoding was replaced with LUT decode plus K-split-safe scale-tiled helpers that use one scale load per scale vector, aligned uint32 packed FP4 loads when safe, and byte fallbacks for unaligned or tail cases.
